items.source:
The file contents are either stored in memory or temporarily on disk.
In either case, the user is responsible for copying file contents to a
session-level or persistent store as and if desired. The temporary storage
will be cleared at the end of request processing.
items.translation: 文件内容存储在内存中或临时磁盘上。无论哪种情况，用户都负责根据需要将文件内容复制到会话级或持久化存储中。临时存储将在请求处理结束时被清除。

items.source: The default implementation simply copies the file input stream.
items.translation: 默认实现只是复制文件输入流。

items.source: Return a Resource representation of this MultipartFile. This can be used as input to the RestTemplate or the WebClient to expose content length and the filename along with the InputStream.
items.translation: 返回此 `MultipartFile` 的 `Resource` 表示形式。这可以作为 `RestTemplate` 或 `WebClient` 的输入，以公开内容长度和文件名以及 `InputStream`。

items.source: Return the contents of the file as an array of bytes.
items.translation: 返回文件内容作为字节数组。

items.source: Return the content type of the file.
items.translation: 返回文件的内容类型。

items.source: Return the name of the parameter in the multipart form.
items.translation: 返回 multipart 表单中参数的名称。

items.source: Return the size of the file in bytes.
items.translation: 返回文件的大小（以字节为单位）。

items.source:
Return whether the uploaded file is empty, that is, either no file has
been chosen in the multipart form or the chosen file has no content.
items.translation: 返回上传的文件是否为空，即多部分表单中未选择任何文件，或所选文件没有内容。

items.source: Transfer the received file to the given destination file.
items.translation: 将接收到的文件传输到指定的目标文件。

items.source: IOException - in case of access errors (if the temporary store fails)
items.translation: IOException - 在访问错误（如果临时存储失败）的情况下

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Trevor D. Cook
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller，Trevor D. Cook

items.source: this MultipartFile adapted to the Resource contract
items.translation: 此 MultipartFile 已适配到 Resource 合约。

items.source: Note: Please keep in mind this filename is supplied by the client and should not be used blindly. In addition to not using the directory portion, the file name could also contain characters such as ".." and others that can be used maliciously. It is recommended to not use this filename directly. Preferably generate a unique one and save this one somewhere for reference, if necessary.
items.translation: 注意： 请牢记，此文件名由客户端提供，不应盲目使用。除了不要使用目录部分外，文件名还可能包含如 ".." 等可用于恶意用途的字符。建议不要直接使用此文件名。最好生成一个唯一的文件名，并在必要时将其保存在某处以备参考。

items.source: NOTE: Depending on the underlying provider, temporary storage may be container-dependent, including the base directory for relative destinations specified here (for example, with Servlet multipart handling). For absolute destinations, the target file may get renamed/moved from its temporary location or newly copied, even if a temporary copy already exists.
items.translation: 注意： 取决于底层提供者，临时存储可能依赖于容器，包括此处指定的相对目标的基础目录（例如，在使用 Servlet 多部分处理时）。对于绝对目标，即使已存在临时副本，目标文件也可能从其临时位置被重命名/移动或重新复制。

items.source:
This may contain path information depending on the browser used,
but it typically will not with any other than Opera.
items.translation: 这可能会包含路径信息，具体取决于所使用的浏览器，但通常除了 Opera 以外的其他浏览器都不会包含。

items.source: The user is responsible for closing the returned stream.
items.translation: 用户负责关闭返回的流。

items.source:
This may either move the file in the filesystem, copy the file in the
filesystem, or save memory-held contents to the destination file. If the
destination file already exists, it will be deleted first.
items.translation: 这可能会在文件系统中移动该文件、复制该文件到文件系统中，或将内存中的内容保存到目标文件。如果目标文件已存在，则先将其删除。

items.source:
If the target file has been moved in the filesystem, this operation
cannot be invoked again afterwards. Therefore, call this method just once
in order to work with any storage mechanism.
items.translation: 如果目标文件在文件系统中已被移动，则此操作之后无法再次调用。因此，请仅调用一次此方法以处理任何存储机制。

items.source: Return an InputStream to read the contents of the file from.
items.translation: 返回一个 InputStream，用于读取文件内容。

items.source: Return the original filename in the client's filesystem.
items.translation: 返回客户端文件系统中的原始文件名。

items.source: Return a Resource representation of this MultipartFile.
items.translation: 返回该 MultipartFile 的 Resource 表示形式。

items.source: getInputStream in interface InputStreamSource
items.translation: `getInputStream` 接口 `InputStreamSource` 中

items.source: IOException - in case of reading or writing errors
items.translation: IOException - 在发生读取或写入错误时

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the file has already been moved in the filesystem and is not available anymore for another transfer
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果文件已在文件系统中移动，不再可用于其他传输

items.source: the name of the parameter (never null or empty)
items.translation: 参数的名称（永远不为null或空）

items.source: the original filename, or the empty String if no file has been chosen in the multipart form, or null if not defined or not available
items.translation: 原始文件名，如果未选择文件则为空字符串，如果在多部分表单中则为此值，或者如果未定义或不可用则为 `null`。

items.source: the content type, or null if not defined (or no file has been chosen in the multipart form)
items.translation: 内容类型，或者如果未定义（或在多部分表单中未选择任何文件）则为 `null`。

items.source: dest - the destination file (typically absolute)
items.translation: dest - 目标文件（通常为绝对路径）

items.source: the size of the file, or 0 if empty
items.translation: 文件大小，如果为空则为 0

items.source: the contents of the file as bytes, or an empty byte array if empty
items.translation: 文件的内容（以字节形式），如果为空则为空字节数组。

items.source: the contents of the file as stream, or an empty stream if empty
items.translation: 文件的内容作为流，如果为空则为空流。
